# Meridian pricing

FIXTURE PAGE — fictional company, used only by the context-compiler tests.

## How we talk about price

We lead with the outcome (fewer unplanned line stops), never with the per-seat number. The number
comes after the buyer has agreed on the problem. Discounting is a last resort and is always traded
for something: a reference call, a case study, or a longer term.

## Discount authority

Anything beyond fifteen percent needs the CEO. Between five and fifteen percent is the VP Sales's
call. Below five percent any account executive may decide without asking.

## Packaging questions we have not settled

Whether the ERP connector is included in the base seat price or sold as an add-on is still open.
Two customers assume it is included because an earlier proposal said so.
